subject: expression: label more expressions as thread-safe and add more test cases (#57171)
summary: Diff moves several builtins (IN for int/string/real/decimal/time/duration and IS TRUE/FALSE for int/real/decimal) from always-thread-unsafe to SafeToShareAcrossSession via generator special-casing + regenerated SafeToShareAcrossSession methods, and adds instance plan cache concurrency tests. Reviewed the affected builtin implementations: their extra fields (hash sets, non-const arg indices, keepNull) are constructed during build and read-only during eval, with map/set lookups only; no eval-time mutation of receiver state was found. Later upstream history (remotes/pingcap/master) keeps these functions marked thread-safe (no revert/fix indicating a latent high-severity issue).
